Market today: The market is showing mixed signals. While there's some renewed institutional interest in AI data centers, the dominant mood is risk-off, with bond yields sinking as investors seek safety. This is tough for your concentrated, leveraged tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-62.56%), MUU (-37.4%), SMCI (-24.82%), and SPAL (-37.26%) are all leveraged "SELL" positions with stops that are significantly above current prices, indicating deep losses and failed stop-loss execution. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements for broader market sentiment, and any further signs of institutional commitment to the AI trade.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions before considering new opportunities.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is completely broken with the price at 84.14. Consider a hard trim or exit to prevent further decay and manage margin.
MUU, SMCI, SPAL, SMH: These leveraged "SELL" positions also have stops above current prices, indicating significant losses. Review these stops and consider trimming to reduce overall portfolio risk.
PLTU: With the "AI trade" headline and scanner "ACCUMULATE" at 9/12, consider adding to your existing PLTU position. Scanner entry 61.14-60.93, stop 60.5.
